description: Page through the reusable skills saved in one private Space. Reads your Personal Space unless space_id names another, never look across Spaces and never create Personal; an entry in a shared Space needs its space_id. To find Community skills, use knowledge_search. Open one with skill_get. A page can be empty while has_more is true, so continue with next_cursor.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous page.

regex.description: Filter skills by regex on name, description, path. Needs sign-in. No lookaround, backreferences or \p; \w \d \s \b are ASCII. Case-insensitive, ^ $ per line, . stops at newlines: (?-i) (?-m) (?s) at the start change that. At most 256 characters and 62 positions: one per character, class or anchor, counting each alternative and repeated copy, so .* not .{0,100}. limit counts rows read; an empty page with has_more true means keep paging.

space_id.description: A private Space from space_list. Omit for your Personal Space.

name: skill_list
title: List private skills
